data.rationale:
No test contracts or staging endpoints are available for Experian or DocuSign at this time.
Integration adapters will need to be validated using mocks or sandbox arrangements until contracts are provisioned.

Repository-level mapping will be a mono-repo. Solution decisions should reference package/module boundaries
within the mono-repo rather than separate repository names.

A single delivery team will own the newly proposed services (scoring pipeline and immutable audit store).
The team will be responsible for SLAs, POCs, and integration test coordination.
